apis.name: RAWG Video Games Database
apis.why_notable: Largest video game database API with 500k+ games, screenshots, stores, and genres; free key.

apis.name: IGDB (Internet Game Database)
apis.why_notable: Twitch/Amazon-owned game metadata API used industry-wide; rich relations and advanced search.

apis.name: BoardGameGeek XML API2
apis.why_notable: Canonical board-game catalog and collection API; community ratings, ranks, and hot lists.

apis.name: PokéAPI
apis.why_notable: Free, no-auth REST/GraphQL encyclopedia for Pokémon species, moves, sprites, and games.

apis.name: CheapShark
apis.why_notable: Game deal aggregator across digital stores; price alerts and historical lows, free no-key use.

apis.name: Giant Bomb
apis.why_notable: Long-running game wiki API with reviews, videos, characters, and franchise data.

apis.name: Steam Web API
apis.why_notable: Valve’s official API for player profiles, owned games, achievements, and app details.

apis.name: Riot Games API
apis.why_notable: Official competitive data for League of Legends, Valorant, TFT, and other Riot titles.

apis.name: Open Dota
apis.why_notable: Open source Dota 2 match, hero, and player analytics API with generous free access.

apis.name: PokeTCG
apis.why_notable: Complete Pokémon TCG card database with sets, prices, and images; free developer key.

apis.name: Scryfall
apis.why_notable: Best Magic: The Gathering card search API; rulings, printings, bulk data, no key needed.

apis.name: Lichess
apis.why_notable: Open chess platform API: games, puzzles, tournaments, bots, and real-time board streams.

apis.name: Chess.com Published Data API
apis.why_notable: Public player profiles, archives, clubs, and daily puzzles from the largest chess site.

apis.name: Comic Vine
apis.why_notable: Largest comic encyclopedia API: characters, volumes, issues, publishers, and people.

apis.name: Marvel Comics API
apis.why_notable: Official Marvel comics, characters, series, and events catalog with image assets.

apis.name: Deck of Cards API
apis.why_notable: Simple free API to shuffle, draw, and pile playing cards for game prototypes.

apis.name: TCGDEX
apis.why_notable: Multilingual Pokémon TCG API with sets, cards, and series; free and open.

apis.name: FreeToGame
apis.why_notable: Catalog of free-to-play MMO/browser games with filters by platform and genre.

apis.name: Mojang API
apis.why_notable: Minecraft account/profile and session endpoints used by launchers and server tools.

apis.name: Hypixel API
apis.why_notable: Minecraft network stats API for player, guild, and skyblock data; free key.

apis.name: HearthstoneJSON
apis.why_notable: Community Hearthstone card and metadata dumps as JSON; free bulk endpoints.

apis.name: Brawl Stars API
apis.why_notable: Supercell official player, club, and battle log API with free developer keys.

apis.name: Clash of Clans API
apis.why_notable: Supercell official clan, player, war, and league endpoints; free key signup.

apis.name: Anilist GraphQL
apis.why_notable: Anime/manga GraphQL API widely used for tracking, search, and media metadata.

apis.name: Jikan (MyAnimeList Unofficial)
apis.why_notable: REST wrapper over MyAnimeList data for anime, manga, characters, and users.

apis.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! API (YGOPRODeck)
apis.why_notable: Yu-Gi-Oh card database with images, sets, archetypes, and banlist info; free.
